verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a REST API and a comprehensive Editor API for programmatic scene/asset manipulation, plus an official MCP server enabling AI agents to drive the Editor, which directly supports AI-native automation. However, there's no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (openapi probe returned 404s), and REST API access is gated behind paid plans rather than freely documented for all users. missing for 10: a public machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/Swagger), fuller REST API endpoint documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of REST API usage by AI agents.
